annotations.title: Upload files to an existing site

description: Add or replace files on an EXISTING roost. Pass `hatchId` plus a `manifest` listing each file's path, size, and optional content type. Returns one presigned PUT URL per file — upload bytes directly via HTTP (e.g. `curl -T file.png -H 'Content-Type: image/png' "$url"`). Files go live immediately as each PUT completes; no separate publish call is needed. Use after regenerating a dashboard locally; Hatch does not schedule regenerations.

hatchId.description: Hatch id from the original hatch response.

files.description: Relative path → { size in bytes, optional contentType }.

policy.description: HITL policy override. Under `required`, may fork a sibling `{slug}-vN` instead of overwriting.

sessionToken.description: Optional paired session token from poll_pairing (when Authorization headers are unavailable).

tenantId.description: Legacy alias for `hatchId` from the original hatch response.

name: upload
title: Upload files to an existing site
